verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions configuring pay frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), and nothing shows assigning different pay schedules to different teams. The 'create and share schedules' item refers to employee work schedules and timesheets, an adjacent time-tracking feature, not pay schedules. Auto payroll and same-day or next-day deposit timing are adjacent payroll-run features that do not establish multiple pay schedules.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
